tips_en: Read PDRVLA first: it offers a focused, practically validated approach to giving robot policies compact physical-dynamics representations while avoiding the latency of online video prediction. Together, the papers form a progression from latent dynamics for control (PDRVLA), to explicit interactive video world generation (Hy-Nomas), to recursively improving agents and their environments (The Trinity).
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 PDRVLA：它以紧凑的物理动力学表征增强机器人策略，同时避免在线视频预测带来的延迟，方法集中且实验结果扎实。三篇论文可视为递进关系：PDRVLA 面向控制中的隐式动力学，Hy-Nomas 探索显式交互式世界生成，The Trinity 则研究智能体与可验证环境的递归协同进化。
